name: KRONO
recent: Kronologi Asia Berhad 在截至2026年7月31日的季度发布了业绩，营收同比增长4.8%，但净利润同比下降25.9%。公司近期有多项「OTHERS」类公告，但未提供具体内容。新闻主要关注其2026财年上半年盈利能力下滑。
notable: 截至2026年7月31日的季度净利润同比下降25.9%至112万令吉。
2026财年上半年净利润同比下降17%，毛利率下滑5.3个百分点。
risks: 净利润同比下降25.9%，净利率仅1.8%。
毛利率下滑5.3个百分点，运营利润下降20%。
earnings: 截至2026年7月31日的季度，营收为6207万令吉，同比增长4.8%，环比增长0.2%；净利润为112万令吉，同比下降25.9%，环比增长11.4%；净利率为1.8%，高于上一季度的1.6%。

recent_en: Kronologi Asia Berhad reported results for the quarter ended 31 July 2026, with revenue up 4.8% year-on-year but net profit down 25.9%. The company has issued several 'OTHERS' announcements recently without disclosed details. News coverage focused on its weaker profitability in 1H 2026.
notable_en: Net profit for the quarter ended 31 July 2026 fell 25.9% year-on-year to MYR 1.12 million.
1H 2026 net profit declined 17% year-on-year as gross margin slipped 5.3 percentage points.
risks_en: Net profit fell 25.9% year-on-year with a net margin of only 1.8%.
Gross margin slipped 5.3 percentage points and operating profit fell 20%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 62.07 million, up 4.8% year-on-year and 0.2% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 1.12 million, down 25.9% year-on-year but up 11.4% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 1.8%, up from 1.6% in the previous quarter.
